name: harness-codex
description: Codex-adapted port of revfactory/harness for designing reusable workflows, role documents, and installable skills.

interface.shortDescription: Meta-skill for designing Codex-compatible workflows and project-specific skills.
interface.longDescription: Harness Codex ports the core idea of revfactory/harness into the current Codex runtime. It helps analyze a domain, define reusable role documents, draft installable skills, and package the result as a Codex-friendly plugin or local workspace artifact without assuming unsupported runtime APIs.
defaultPrompt: Build a harness for this project.
Design a Codex workflow for this domain.
Audit and extend the existing harness.
